messages:
incident-bot: P1 alert — high rate of tool/function-call parser errors for tenant 'Saffron Health' on dedicated pool ded-eu-3. Error rate spiked to 48% for tool_call responses in the last 5m. Paging oncall. link: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/1965432100 :rotating_light:

Diego (Eng Oncall): Acked. I'm on it. Which stack — runtime or gateway? Any obvious recent deploys?

incident-bot: Recent model variant rollout to 'rwd-open-llama-v2-7b-q' on ded-eu-3 ~ 25m ago. Gateway routing unchanged. Errors are JSON parse failures from tool outputs (invalid schema). Top error sample: `parse_error: Unexpected token` (see logs).

Maya (SRE): @Diego thanks. @Harini can you confirm if Saffron reported customer-facing failures?

Harini (Customer Success): We just got a page from their oncall. Several of their customers saw tool actions fail (orders, scheduling). Saffron-SRE says ~120 failed tool calls in last 10m, intermittent 502/parse errors. They flagged that tool payload keys changed (camelCase -> snake_case). They're on a dedicated pool so tenant isolation is preserved but impact to their workflows is high.

Saffron-SRE: Confirming — our production users saw a stream of failures after ~10:37 UTC. Example failing response from Redwood: 
```json
{"tool_name":"create_appointment","arguments":"{\"patient_id\":123, \"appointment_time\": \"2026-03-15T10:40:00Z\"}"}
```
We expect structured JSON in `arguments` (not a string) and field `patientId` (camelCase). Parser is choking when arguments is a stringified JSON. We didn't change anything on our side.

Diego (Eng Oncall): That payload makes sense — looks like model produced stringified JSON instead of object and changed key casing. This smells like a model function-schema regression introduced in the new variant.

Maya (SRE): Impact assessment: Saffron only on ded-eu-3, so blast radius limited to them. Risk: can't just rollback the dedicated infra quickly if it's a single tenant-managed variant. We can either: 1) rollback model in that pool; 2) apply parser shim at gateway to coerce into expected shape; 3) enable conservative fallback (disable toolcalls for Saffron temporarily). Thoughts?

Simon (Platform): If we rollback model variant for ded-eu-3, we need a redeploy across that pool — doable but has 5-10m time to converge and potential brief disruption. Gateway shim is faster (edge transform) and reversible. We have a small shim we used previously for schema-drift: repo: infra/toolcall-shims.

Eva (SRE): Can we try the shim as first mitigation to buy time? Add transformation: if arguments is a string, attempt JSON.parse; map snake_case -> camelCase for keys listed in Saffron's schema. Quick patch can be applied to the routing lambda in front of the parser.

Diego (Eng Oncall): I can roll that out. Plan: 1) enable ephemeral shim for tenant_id:saffron on gateway; 2) monitor errors/latency; 3) if mitigation fails, rollback model. Applying shim now.

Diego (Eng Oncall): Applying shim — running helper: 
```bash
# apply tenant-level transform
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP' \
  https://api.redwood/internal/adm/shim -d '{"tenant":"saffron","shim":"parse-arguments-and-case-map-v1"}'
```

incident-bot: Deploy started by Diego (request id: ci-1965432100-apply-shim). Canary will route 5% of saffron traffic through shim for 2m then 25% then 100%.

Maya (SRE): Runbook link: https://redwood/runbooks/toolcall-schema-drift — note recommended safe mode is to disable toolcalls if parsing cannot be recovered.

Saffron-SRE: Thanks — we see a drop in failed tool calls immediately. Error rate down from 48% -> 6% in the last 3m after the shim. Please keep us posted, we will keep CS updated.

Harini (Customer Success): Noted, Saffron is confirming business impact reduced. They're ok with shim for now but want permanent fix.

Diego (Eng Oncall): Canary success — promoting to 25% then 100%. Monitoring token-level latency — small +20ms increase for shim path. No new errors.

Eva (SRE): Observability notes: captured example transformed payload post-shim: 
```json
{"tool_name":"create_appointment","arguments":{"patientId":123,"appointmentTime":"2026-03-15T10:40:00Z"}}
```
Shim also added a safe parse guard to avoid throwing on malformed strings.

Simon (Platform): I'll open infra PR to harden shims and add tenant-scoped toggles + audit logs. Also scheduling model rollback verification in case this recurs.

Maya (SRE): Quick RCA hypothesis: new model variant changed function-calling behavior (stringified arguments + snake_case). Root cause likely model tokenizer/adapter patch or function schema blanking. We need to sync with model-onboarding team.

Diego (Eng Oncall): Filing ticket now: INF-8672 — model variant rwd-open-llama-v2-7b-q introduced function-call schema change; create regression test with Saffron prompt set.

Saffron-SRE: Verified 0% new production errors after full shim rollout. We'll accept shim short-term. We need timeline for permanent fix (rollback or model patch) — prefer rollback if it doesn't cause downtime.

Harini (Customer Success): I'll coordinate SL and postmortem with Saffron. They want a writeup and ETA.

Maya (SRE): Action items: Diego — keep shim enabled and produce rollback playbook if needed (due 1h). Simon — infra PR for shims + tenant toggles (due EOD). Eva — add regression alert for function-call schema delta (alerts+dashboards). Harini — CS comms with Saffron. I'll take the incident to postmortem.

Diego (Eng Oncall): Adding note: if we ever need to rollback model variant for a dedicated pool, we should use staged deployment to avoid flapping. I'll prepare playbook lines.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated for now (P1 -> P2). Monitoring will auto-close if error rate stays <2% for 30m. Incident channel will be kept open for handoff.

Maya (SRE): Handoff to Eva for the overnight watch. Eva, can you own the next 4h and coordinate with the model-onboarding folks tomorrow?

Eva (SRE): Taking watch. I'll ping model team and schedule triage with them in their timezone.

Diego (Eng Oncall): Thanks all. Harini, please send the brief to Saffron. We'll follow up with postmortem and long-term remediation plan. :white_check_mark:

Saffron-SRE: Appreciate the fast response, team. We'll be available for any follow-up testing.

Maya (SRE): Closing note: postmortem scheduled for 2026-03-16 09:00 UTC. Attach logs/trace ids to INF-8672.

Diego (Eng Oncall): End of thread.
